chars.MOM: MOM: a stern Moroccan woman in her early 60s wearing a dark green djellaba with gold trim, a white headscarf and thin gold-rimmed glasses
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his early 30s with a short black beard, wearing a burgundy zip windbreaker over a white t-shirt and dark jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her mid 20s with long dark hair tied back, wearing a light blue denim jacket over a long beige dress
chars.THUG: THUG: a skinny young Moroccan man with shaved sides, a scar on his cheek, a shiny red tracksuit and a thick gold chain

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan living room in Fes with blue-patterned sedari sofas. Seen from the doorway, head-to-waist: MOM points an accusing finger and glares angrily toward an unseen room, face clearly visible, while NARRATOR stands beside her raising both palms trying to calm her, worried smile. Subjects centered.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the same Moroccan living room: NARRATOR gently holds MOM's shoulders and talks softly to calm her; MOM folds her arms and looks away unconvinced, lips pressed. Faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A small bedroom in a Fes apartment at night: WIFE sits at a desk studying with university books and a laptop, smiling, while NARRATOR stands behind her proudly placing a cup of tea next to her books. Warm lamp light, faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The open front door of a Moroccan apartment building stairwell: MOM argues loudly with a middle-aged neighbour woman in a grey djellaba, waving her hand dramatically; the neighbour looks offended. Faces visible, subjects centered, calm stairwell background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment entrance hall: a younger brother (a slim man in his 20s in a black hoodie) walks out the front door carrying a sports bag, angry, without looking back, while NARRATOR watches from the hallway, sad and helpless. Faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A narrow old-medina derb alley in Fes in the late afternoon, seen from behind a corner wall as if someone is secretly watching: MOM stands very close to THUG, holding his shoulder and whispering to him seriously; THUG listens and nods with a sly grin. Head-to-waist, both faces visible, centered, calm alley walls at the edges.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the same narrow derb alley: NARRATOR confronts MOM with a suspicious frown, hands open asking a question; MOM smiles innocently and touches her chest as if saying she did nothing wrong. Faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A dim Moroccan living room by a window with iron grille: WIFE sits on the sofa hugging her knees, frightened and anxious, glancing toward the window and the street outside. Face visible, centered, soft evening light.
